messages:
sam: quick heads-up — fallback telemetry is broken again. when tenants overflow Dedicated -> Hosted we're losing pool/operator metadata and billing/alerts show spikes.
katie: is the breakdown during routing or at hosted ingress? seen both.
omar: hosted ingress strips unknown headers to avoid spoofing. we canonicalize a tenant id and drop anything else.
sam: problem is eviction_priority and operator tag were in Dedicateds lease. without them hosted assigns default QoS and metrics become noisy.
lia: short-term: make the router attach an internal header `x-rw-lease-meta` with base64 claims and mark it internal-only. quick and low risk.
katie: long-term we should issue signed lease tokens (JWS) from controlplane with claims {sub,pool_id,operator,eviction,iat,exp,nonce}. hosted validates signature.
omar: signed token portability matters for cross-region/proxy hops. header attachments risk being dropped by frontdoors.
lia: security notes: tokens must be short-lived (<=60s). consider single-use nonces vs stateless HMAC+exp tradeoff. single-use needs fast nonce store; HMAC needs short TTL.
sam: private deployments: customers may run their own controlplane. plan: accept tokens signed by trusted CAs configured in customer manifest or require customer KMS to issue tokens. opt-in flag `propagate_operator` in customer manifest.
katie: telemetry: ensure `traceparent` + `redwood.operator` propagate so traces/metrics map to original pool. add audit log `fallback.attached` with original_pool for reconciliation.
infra-bot: Incident 2024-04-03: fallback attribution gap. Interim mitigation recommended: header attach behind feature flag.
omar: implementation plan: 1) header-attach quick patch behind flag (router); 2) design token v2 + go validation lib; 3) hosted validation + legacy_priority_mapper; 4) e2e handshake tests and header-drop fuzz.
lia: I'll own header attach PR and tests. sam will own runbook and revocation flow. katie will draft token claims. omar will add hosted validation + mapper.
sam: action items summary:
- router: header attach (flagged) + audit logging
- auth: token v2 spec (JWS) + TTL/nonce decision
- hosted: validate tokens + fallback priority mapper
- infra: end-to-end handshake tests + header-drop chaos
- security: key rotation + revocation playbook
katie: timeline: header patch in 1-2 weeks, token v2 draft in 3w, hosted validation 5-7w.
infra-bot: Follow-up meeting scheduled Fri 09:30 (invite: sam,katie,omar,lia).
